description: Department of Fiscal Policy - Order made to amend the Order published under Sec. 2(1) of the Finance Act No. 25 of 2003 w.e.f. 01.01.2016
reasoning: This gazette content is an Order made under Section 2(1) of The Finance Act, No. 25 of 2003, which amends a previous order by replacing Schedule I. It involves the modification of a regulatory framework (specifically, departure fees from Sri Lanka) through statutory authority. This falls squarely under Legal/Regulatory matters (Type 5) as it constitutes subsidiary legislation and regulatory amendments. While it mentions a Minister by name, it does not describe his portfolio responsibilities in detail, nor does it focus on government structure or personnel changes, so government classification types (1-3) do not take precedence.
